name: ARM
summary: Ray-casting with a button that switches to a precise relative mode, so small, distant targets become easier to hit.
howItWorks: Pointing is absolute (1:1) by default. Pressing a button invokes a precision mode with a 10:1 control-display ratio that damps wrist rotations, effectively enlarging nearby targets; pressing again returns to the absolute mapping. It can be combined with zooming into the area under the cursor.

relationships.note: Adds a manually switched precision mode to ray-casting.
Both change the gain of a pointer to aid precision.
